description: Creates a new campaign: the seller's design printed on a catalogue product (plus optional additional products), with selling price and colours. The design is an image uploaded on a personal Hoplix upload page (front_design_upload_id / back_design_upload_id) or a public http(s) URL of a PNG or JPG image (front_image_url / back_image_url). A transparent PNG at the size given in the product "pixel" field gives the best print. A public campaign gets its own page on Hoplix at the chosen url; a private one is only for the seller's own orders. Returns the campaign id.

additional_products.description: Other products with the same design, among the additional products of the main product

back_design_upload_id.description: UPL-... id of an uploaded image, used as back design (alternative to back_image_url)

back_image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of the back design (PNG or JPG), only for products with two print sides

description.description: Campaign description shown on the public page (defaults to the name)

front_design_upload_id.description: UPL-... id of an uploaded image, used as front design (alternative to front_image_url)

front_image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of the front design (PNG or JPG)

private.description: true = private campaign, only for the seller's own orders (default false)

product_code.description: Catalogue product code of the main product

product_colors.description: Colours of the main product, from the product colours

product_price.description: Selling price in EUR, VAT included; for public campaigns at least the base cost (base-cost-back when printing front and back)

url.description: Public page slug: letters, digits and hyphens, must be unused (required unless private)

name: create_campaign
title: Create a campaign
